3812-6006-7008.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3812-6006-7008.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

141-2438-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2438-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-3899-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3899-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-3899-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-2158-3249-7968--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-7968--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Diregraf Colossus triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2374-2841-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2374-2841-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2374-2841-3897.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2374-2841-3897.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

280-5413-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Repeat.

3532-5078-7811-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1368-5223-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5223-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3490-4659-4875-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4659-4875-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Conspiracy, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-5445-6798-7426.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or artifact
3490-5445-6798-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-5445-6798-7426.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature or artifact
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6968-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-6968-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

2267-4050-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

509-1267-3933-5776.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-3933-5776.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-3933-5776.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1879-3457-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1365-2131-3263-4853-7098.notablePrerequisites:
You control two additional nontoken creatures, one of which has another card type besides artifact or creature.
The additional nontoken creatures have base toughness 2 or greater and do not have a -1/-1 counter on them.
1365-2131-3263-4853-7098.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the additional creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Baba Lysaga by tapping it and sacrificing the two additional creatures.
When the creatures die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice and the creatures' persist abilities each trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Baba Lysaga and Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the first persist creature, returning one of the creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Repeat from step 5 for the remaining persist trigger.
Resolve the Baba Lysaga ability from step 2, causing you to gain 3 life, each opponent to lose 3 life, and you to draw three cards.
Repeat.

198-2024-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {G} or {W} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Trazyn and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
198-2024-3918.notes: The mana cost assumes Trazyn has no charge counters on it when you begin the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control that does not have summoning sickness

515-1636-4221.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Living Plane.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-2511-3499.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4381-5641-5662.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter due to Grumgully.
When Basking Broodscale enters, it triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Grumgully.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating an 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter due to Grumgully.
Repeat from step 3.

3086-3175-5256.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3086-3175-5256.description:
Cast Lagrella by paying {G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Lagrella enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sun Titan until Lagrella leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lagrella.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Sun Titan is returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it and Lagrella triggers.
Resolve the Lagrella trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Lagrella from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities.

2034-3593-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Garna, adding {C}{C}.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2034-3593-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

539-4657-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
539-4657-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat.

1558-3529-4231-5361.notablePrerequisites:
Auton Soldier is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-5361.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

313-1742-1745-1818-3503.description:
Cast Spectral Arcanist by paying {3}{U}.
When Spectral Arcanist enters the battlefield, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Holding priority, activate Lord of the Forsaken's second ability twice by paying 2 life, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast a spell from your graveyard.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Corpse Dance, adding {B}.
Activate Lord of the Forsaken's first ability by paying {B} and sacrificing Spectral Arcanist, causing target player to mill three cards.
Resolve the Spectral Arcanist trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {2} to cast Corpse Dance from your graveyard with buyback.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Spectral Arcanist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2397-4813-5003-5147.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
2397-4813-5003-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.

1202-4316-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Moonvessel on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Myr Moonvessel's power.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

313-1170-1594-1749-4113.notablePrerequisites:
Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
You control at least one additional creature.
313-1170-1594-1749-4113.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by tapping Caetus, Vampire Hexmage and two other creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Caetus and causing it to return to the battlefield as Invasion of Segovia.
When Invasion of Segovia enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Kraken creature tokens.
Activate Vampire Hexmage by sacrificing it, removing all counters from Invasion of Segovia.
Invasion of Segovia triggers, causing you to exile it and cast it as Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Vampire Hexmage from your graveyard to the battlefield and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

3781-3998-4215.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken green Insect.
3781-3998-4215.description:
Activate Dross Hopper by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
The Insect dies, triggering Zask and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dross Hopper ability from step 1, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat.

973-997-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

11-1591-1973-3787-5261.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents that can be tapped for at least {6}{U}{U}.
11-1591-1973-3787-5261.description:
During your opponent's upkeep step, Seedborn Muse untaps all permanents you control.
Cast Time Stop.
With Time Stop on the stack, activate Isochron Scepeter, casting a copy of Narset's Reversal.
Copy Time Stop with Narset's Reversal, returning Time Stop to your hand and ending the turn.
Repeat on each opponent's turn.

1309-1518-1964-1987.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1309-1518-1964-1987.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
